title: QuarterMaster faction.toml (schema 1)
description: A faction mod: an army that takes over the Allied or German side. Guide: the modding wiki, Part 3: https://gamiseus.github.io/wiki/faction-mods/

units.description: Art per unit. Allied side: base, sarge, para, french. Axis side: base, officer, volks.

spawn_swap.description: vanilla_tag = weapon_tag. Hands out the second weapon wherever the game hands out the first. Advanced: the tag really changes.

pools.description: Edit the random weapon pools the game draws loot and reinforcement guns from.

classes.description: The 12 class slots. Allied side only.

names.description: Allied side: soldier, french and vehicle names. Axis side: the soldier names name the German commander.

folder.description: Replaces lines in the side's main voice folder (sounds/vo/allied or sounds/vo/axis).

dirs.description: Other vanilla voice folders of the side: vanilla folder name = mod folder (e.g. frenchies = "voices_fr").

fill_missing.description: Reuse the faction's own lines when it has fewer files than vanilla.

map.description: faction file name = vanilla file name, without numbers or extension (hurt = "alliedHurt").

text.description: Game strings to replace, by name (see includes/localisation.lua).

sprites.description: Any other game image to replace while the faction is active: global name = image file, or a table with the file, the size it is shown at and where it sits.

oneOf.description: The image file (or none, to size the game's own image), one of size, scale and like, and where it sits (offset, rotate, flip). Needs "faction_sprite_sizes" in qm_features.

scale.description: A fraction of the file's own pixel size.

like.description: Another image global: shown at the size that one is shown at.

offset.description: [x, y] game pixels to move the image, right and down, inside the place the game draws it.

rotate.description: Degrees to turn the image about its middle, clockwise.

flip.description: Mirror the image about its middle: x left-right, y up-down, xy both.

draw_size.description: [width, height] game pixels to draw the picture at inside its place, while the game's code still sees the original's size.

sounds.description: Any other game sound to replace while the faction is active: global name = sound file.

explosions.description: Explosions on the game's own, with numbers changed. An [[ordnance]] entry names one by its id.

ordnance.description: The faction's ordnance: grenades, rifle grenades, mortars, artillery, air strikes and supply drops, with their own explosions, on a class skill or in place of the game's own.

skills.description: Class skills changed, replaced with another, moved to another level, removed or added.

ranks.description: The rank names shown on the faction's soldiers, and the skill a promotion gives. Needs "ranks" in qm_features.

soldier.description: Ranks 0 to 3 (the game's Private, Private First Class, Corporal, Sergeant).

officer.description: An officer's ranks 0 to 3 (the game's Second Lieutenant, First Lieutenant, Captain, Major).

recruit.description: A soldier with no rank yet (the game's Recruit). The first soldier rank unless set.

cadet.description: An officer with no rank yet (the game's Cadet). The first officer rank unless set.

sarge.description: The Sarge's title: his name, and the word in the game's lines and texts about him. The Allies' only.

promotion_skill.description: The combat skill a soldier gains at promotion to rank 1, 2 and 3 (the game's 5, 10, 15). A missing one keeps the game's; class bonuses are unchanged. The Allies' only. Needs "promotion_skill" in qm_features.

allied.description: The Allied side, when the file replaces the Germans: that side's own keys (units, spawn_swap, classes, names, voices, vehicles, skills, ranks, intro). Needs "faction_sides" in qm_features.

axis.description: The German side, when the file replaces the Allies: that side's own keys (units, spawn_swap, names, voices, vehicles, ranks). Needs "faction_sides" in qm_features.

weapon_kinds.description: Reusable sets of weapon behaviour: what the game decides by a weapon's class or tag. A weapon takes one with kind = "<name>". Needs "weapon_kinds" in qm_features.

intro.description: The words of the game's opening. Needs "faction_intro" in qm_features.

date.description: The date over the landing (the game's "June 6, 1944"). The Allies' only.

unit.description: The unit line under the date (the game's "Company C, 116th Regiment, 29th div"). The Allies' only.

lines.description: Lines on the first screen, under "URB and the MNB community presents". Either side.

path.description: Path relative to the mod folder. No drive letters, no leading slash.

slot.description: 1 to 3: one of the class's own skills; 4 and up: new skills above them.

name.description: Its mouse-over text, before the description.

description.description: Its mouse-over text, after the name.

cooldown.description: Seconds before it is ready again.

unlock.description: The skill level it comes with (its slot, or 3 for a new skill, unless set).

game.description: A game skill: 2 (the class's own skill 2) or "light:3" (any class's).

ordnance.description: An [[ordnance]] id of this faction, thrown, fired or called in.

remove.description: The class has no skill in this slot.

backdrop.description: Its icon is drawn on the game's blank skill button, as the game's skill icons are.

sprite_icon.description: With ordnance: its sprite, on the game's blank skill button, is the icon.

game_grenade.description: frag: the Allied frag; stick_frag: the German stick grenade; contact_frag: the contact frag; at_grenade: the anti-tank grenade; molotov; blendkorper: the gas grenade; smoke: the smoke grenade; rifle_grenade.

name_format.description: initial: "A. Ivanov" (vanilla style). full: "Pyotr Ivanov" (needs first names).

frames.description: Per-frame image files, used instead of the folder's file for that frame.

copy_from.description: Another unit whose faction frames fill this unit's gaps.

reskin.description: Change this vanilla weapon in place.

tag.description: A new weapon's tag. Must not be a vanilla tag.

based_on.description: New weapons: copy this weapon's stats first.

name.description: Used as the squad UI text when there is no description.

sound.description: A game sound by name (springfieldSound), a file, or a name prefix: weapons/mosin loads mosin1.wav, mosin2.wav, ...

mag_sprite.description: The magazine dropped on reload: one of the game's magazines (genericMag, ppshMag, ...), an image file, or a name from [sprites].

pools.description: Random weapon pools this new weapon joins.

replaces_pickup.description: A new weapon: the faction's soldiers get it when they pick up that game AT rifle as loot, in its place. Give it a kind like the AT rifle it replaces, so it keeps the game's AT rifle behaviour. Needs "weapon_kinds" in qm_features.

kind.description: A [weapon_kinds] name: the weapon behaves as that kind says. Its own behaviour keys win over the kind's. Needs "weapon_kinds" in qm_features.

pellets.description: A shotgun's spread: a miss leaves four tracers and no dirt splash. The game's: the shotgun. Needs "weapon_kinds" in qm_features.

miss_morale.description: A miss shakes the target's morale. The game's: AT rifles. Needs "weapon_kinds" in qm_features.

breaks_trees.description: A miss that hits a tree breaks it. The game's: AT rifles. Needs "weapon_kinds" in qm_features.

vehicle_burst.description: The explosion a hit on a vehicle sets off: one of the game's (frag, contact, at_grenade, rifle_grenade, mortar, faust, artillery, heavy_mortar, bomb, strafe, or their game names such as flakExplosion and pzExplosion), an [[explosions]] id of this faction, or "none". The game's: flakExplosion for the Boys rifle, pzExplosion for the PzB 39; heavy_hits = true brings flakExplosion. Needs "weapon_kinds" in qm_features.

gibs.description: A kill can blow the target apart. The game's: AT rifles. Needs "weapon_kinds" in qm_features.

armor_hit.description: A hit on armour plays the AT rifle's hit sound and sparks. The game's: AT rifles. Needs "weapon_kinds" in qm_features.

close_range.description: A shotgun's range: much more accurate and twice the damage up close, weaker far off. The game's: the shotgun. Needs "weapon_kinds" in qm_features.

night_sight.description: The IR StG 44's sight: sees through smoke, spots at night and spots hidden enemies and vehicles. The game's: the IR StG 44. Needs "weapon_kinds" in qm_features.

fires.description: An [[ordnance]] id: a shot leaves as that ordnance towards the target, spread by the shooter's skill, in place of a bullet. A thrown one is lobbed (impact = true makes it go off where it lands); a rifle one flies flat, as a rifle grenade. Needs "weapon_kinds" in qm_features.

fires_chance.description: With fires: the share of shots in percent that leave as the ordnance; the rest are bullets. All of them without it. Needs "weapon_kinds" in qm_features.

fires_ammo.description: With fires: the ordnance's own rounds, apart from the magazine, full again in each battle. An ordnance shot uses a round, not a bullet; out of rounds, the weapon fires bullets. Without it, the magazine is the ordnance. Needs "weapon_kinds" in qm_features.

like.description: A game weapon whose behaviour the kind starts from: every property below as that weapon has it (the Boys rifle's charges and heavy hits, the Sten Mk VI's quiet shots). The kind's own keys go on top.

pellets.description: A shotgun's spread: a miss leaves four tracers and no dirt splash. The game's: the shotgun. Needs "weapon_kinds" in qm_features.

miss_morale.description: A miss shakes the target's morale. The game's: AT rifles. Needs "weapon_kinds" in qm_features.

breaks_trees.description: A miss that hits a tree breaks it. The game's: AT rifles. Needs "weapon_kinds" in qm_features.

vehicle_burst.description: The explosion a hit on a vehicle sets off: one of the game's (frag, contact, at_grenade, rifle_grenade, mortar, faust, artillery, heavy_mortar, bomb, strafe, or their game names such as flakExplosion and pzExplosion), an [[explosions]] id of this faction, or "none". The game's: flakExplosion for the Boys rifle, pzExplosion for the PzB 39; heavy_hits = true brings flakExplosion. Needs "weapon_kinds" in qm_features.

armor_hit.description: A hit on armour plays the AT rifle's hit sound and sparks. The game's: AT rifles. Needs "weapon_kinds" in qm_features.

close_range.description: A shotgun's range: much more accurate and twice the damage up close, weaker far off. The game's: the shotgun. Needs "weapon_kinds" in qm_features.

night_sight.description: The IR StG 44's sight: sees through smoke, spots at night and spots hidden enemies and vehicles. The game's: the IR StG 44. Needs "weapon_kinds" in qm_features.

fires.description: An [[ordnance]] id: a shot leaves as that ordnance towards the target, spread by the shooter's skill, in place of a bullet. A thrown one is lobbed (impact = true makes it go off where it lands); a rifle one flies flat, as a rifle grenade. Needs "weapon_kinds" in qm_features.

fires_chance.description: With fires: the share of shots in percent that leave as the ordnance; the rest are bullets. All of them without it. Needs "weapon_kinds" in qm_features.

fires_ammo.description: With fires: the ordnance's own rounds, apart from the magazine, full again in each battle. An ordnance shot uses a round, not a bullet; out of rounds, the weapon fires bullets. Without it, the magazine is the ordnance. Needs "weapon_kinds" in qm_features.

ammo_mode.description: Where the weapon's shots come from. "magazine": its own ammo and maxAmmo, refilled by reloading. "charges": the shots a soldier gets with an AT rifle he picks up, as the game's AT rifles do; only for AT rifles. The game's: charges for AT rifles, magazine for the rest. Setting it alone also sets when_empty (reload with a magazine, switch_back with charges). Needs "weapon_kinds" in qm_features.

when_empty.description: What a soldier does when the weapon is empty. "reload", or "switch_back" to the gun he had before he picked up an AT rifle (a soldier with none reloads). Weapons on charges always switch back. Needs "weapon_kinds" in qm_features.

game_ordnance.description: One of the game's ordnance: every grenade it throws (frag, loot_frag, contact_frag, at_grenade, molotov, blendkorper, the smoke grenades, flare, kitchen_sink), the rifle grenade, mortar rounds, artillery barrages, bombing and strafing runs, and supply drops.

side_half.description: The other side of the game, in the same file: its own keys only. What both sides share (weapons, kinds, ordnance, explosions, images, sounds, text, pools, hooks) stays at the top level. Needs "faction_sides" in qm_features.

name.description: This side's name. The faction's name unless set.

casing.description: The casing each shot drops. The game's: a small shell for SMGs, a big one for AT rifles, the shotgun's own, a shell for the rest. Needs "weapon_kinds" in qm_features.

tracer.description: The tracer a miss leaves (special ammo keeps its own). The game's: heavy for AT rifles, normal for the rest. Needs "weapon_kinds" in qm_features.

counts_as.description: The role the game's SMG and LMG checks see: an SMG's accuracy up close, an LMG's at long range and its assistant gunner, the AI's squad role. The game's: the weapon's class. Needs "weapon_kinds" in qm_features.

heavy_hits.description: The Boys rifle's hits: a shot smashes the light cover it strikes, and a hit on a vehicle bursts. Needs "weapon_traits" in qm_features.

suppressed.description: The Sten Mk VI's rule: firing does not always break the stealth or camo buff. Each shot gives the shooter away at reveal_chance percent per enemy who sees him. Needs "weapon_traits" in qm_features.

reveal_chance.description: With suppressed: the chance in percent, per enemy who sees the shooter, that a shot gives him away. The game's is 5. Needs "weapon_traits" in qm_features.

bonus.description: Replaces the vanilla bonus for this class when present.

max_health.description: Added (also heals by the same amount).

name.description: Shown instead of the tag in the vehicle tooltip.

parts.description: Other sprites, by the part of the game name after the tag: SecondTurret = ... on the halfTrack replaces halfTrackSecondTurret.

call_signs.description: Call signs this vehicle gets when it spawns (Allied vehicles).

explosion_preset.description: One of the game's explosions, by name or by the game's tag.

based_on.description: The explosion whose numbers it starts from (frag when left out).

id.description: Its name in this faction. Leave it out for a reskin.

reskin.description: One of the game's grenades, drawn and described with this entry's sprite, pack_sprite, loot_sprite and description instead of adding a new one. It changes the grenade wherever the game uses it.

pack_sprite.description: A reskin: the image on a soldier who carries it.

loot_sprite.description: A reskin: the image of its loot on the ground. The anti-tank grenade, molotov and Blendkorper fly as their loot image, so for them sprite and loot_sprite are one image.

kind.description: thrown: a hand grenade, as the frag (the default); rifle: fired from a rifle that takes rifle grenades, as the game's rifle grenade; mortar: a soldier's mortar rounds; artillery: a barrage called on a spot; airstrike: a plane's bombs or strafing on a spot; drop: a supply crate by parachute.

name.description: Shown on a fourth skill's button.

description.description: Shown on a fourth skill's button, after the name. A reskin: the text over its loot.

sprite.description: The image it flies as. Required for a thrown or rifle grenade; a mortar round or a shell shows only its blast. A reskin: the image the game's grenade flies as.

shots.description: A mortar's rounds each time (6), a barrage's shells (5), an air strike's hits (1) or the items in a drop's crate (3).

plane.description: An air strike or a drop: the plane that flies over (the game's unless set).

contents.description: A drop: the game's loot names its crate holds, such as loot_medPack or loot_ration (the game's own mix unless set).

spread.description: How far each round or shell lands from the last (150 for a mortar, 250 for artillery).

explosion.description: An explosion of this faction by id, one of the game's (frag when left out; rifle_grenade for a rifle grenade), or one of the game's grenade effects (smoke, red_smoke, pink_smoke, grey_smoke, purple_smoke, yellow_smoke, blue_smoke, molotov, blendkorper; needs "ordnance_effects" in qm_features).

range.description: The farthest a soldier throws or fires it (1000, as the game's).

cooldown.description: Seconds before the class skill is ready again (120; 180 for a rifle grenade).

tension.description: The battle's tension after the blast (40; a rifle grenade leaves it unless set).

skill.description: The class skill that throws it instead of what it did.

slot.description: 1 to 3: one of the class's own skills; 4 and up: new skills above them.

unlock.description: The skill level it comes with (its slot, or 3 for a new skill, unless set).

icon.description: The skill's icon (a game skill's own, a replaced one too, or the sprite on the blank skill button for a new one, unless set).

backdrop.description: The icon is drawn on the game's blank skill button, as the game's skill icons are.

sprite_icon.description: The grenade's sprite, on the game's blank skill button, is the icon.

spin.description: A thrown grenade: how fast it turns in the air (the frag's is 0.1 to 1 at random). 0 flies pointing the way it was thrown.

speed.description: A thrown or rifle grenade: how fast it flies. The game's grenades fly at 500, its contact grenade at 600. Needs "ordnance_speed" in qm_features.

impact.description: A thrown grenade: it goes off where it lands or where it hits a wall, as an impact fuse, instead of bouncing.

replaces.description: What of the game's it stands in for: one name, a list of names, or a table of name = side ("allied", "axis" or "both"). Thrown names take a thrown or rifle grenade (a rifle one flies flat); rifle_grenade a rifle one; mortar, artillery, bombing, strafing and supply_drop their own kinds. A side another mod's faction holds keeps its own. Needs "ordnance_replaces" in qm_features.

sides.description: Whose, for a replaces name or list: "allied", "axis" or "both". The sides the faction holds unless set. Needs "ordnance_replaces" in qm_features.

replaces_frag.description: The older spelling of replaces = "frag" (true: the sides the faction holds).

replaces_rifle_grenade.description: The older spelling of replaces = "rifle_grenade" (true: the sides the faction holds).

replaces_mortar.description: The older spelling of replaces = "mortar" (true: the sides the faction holds).

replaces_artillery.description: The older spelling of replaces = "artillery" (true: the sides the faction holds).

replaces_bombing.description: The older spelling of replaces = "bombing" (true: the sides the faction holds).

replaces_strafing.description: The older spelling of replaces = "strafing" (true: the sides the faction holds).

replaces_drop.description: The older spelling of replaces = "supply_drop" (true: the sides the faction holds).
